process_observations.observation: The third amendment's record (who, when, why and the prior test list) and the tester's skipped_manual entries, each quoting its expected timing, were enough to set every split case's gate (four UAT-after-deploy, six M4-gate) without interpretation.

Each of the six declared M4-S03/M4-S04 outputs has its slice row (CWB-OTHER-026..031), and both docs steps now carry a requirement (REQ-027, REQ-028), so the coverage line reports no step without a requirement for the first time in this build.

decisions.md records three M4-S04 findings twice - O-M4S04-01/02/03 (operator) and O-M4S04-05/06/07 (renderer, from the builder envelope) - so the pack folds each pair into one case; a reader counting open items over-counts by three.

M4-S04 test 4's Then ('the only org-facing command it offers is scripts/mock_deploy.py') is false against the built runbook by the operator's own record (O-M4S04-04), and the plan text still says it; the pack can only name the gap on TC-M4-S04-T4 for the gate to rule on.

Assumption A37 and Q8 still say the 140-deal reassignment needs no field mapping, while O-M4S04-02 records that it does; the workbook's Assumptions Register carries A37 verbatim from plan.json, so the two compiled documents disagree until the assumption is amended.

render_step_docs.py again wrote renderer-shaped traceability cells (REQ-027's artefact holds four paths, REQ-028's is empty, both artefact_paths are directories) and skipped CWB-OTHER-024/025 in the slice; the compile normalizes ten rows now, each recorded in the matrix's normalization list.

Beyond the listed items, five statements that M4-S04 being documented made false were corrected: the preconditions and gaps of TC-M4-T4, TC-M4-T5 and TC-O-M2S03-03, CWB-DATA-001's '(pending)', and the workbook's M4-S04 header sentence and gap bullet. The operator may prefer them verbatim.

REQ-010 moved to In UAT under Step 7's mechanical rule (every step documented, manual test outstanding), while M1-S02's own cell says the row stays In Build until a shipped Layout carries the relatedLists block; nothing ships one, and the requirement is covered by a runbook check.

M4-S04 test 12 names no persona and no 'other' user; TC-M4-S04-T12 uses P-REP to collapse the Path and P-MGR as the 'others', with a data precondition that P-MGR has not collapsed it before. O-M4S03-01/02 were dispositioned too, though the brief named only M4-S04's open items, so that every open item stays accounted for.

REQ-027 reads In UAT while this run has M4-S03 reopened (documented -> running -> built); the cell is carried verbatim with a note, and it is accurate again once the step is re-tested and re-documented.
M4-S03 returns to built with new file hashes; tests/M4-S03/results.json artefact_hashes now describe the previous compile.
